capabilities: Delete, move, or archive completed recurring task instances in the active note via a single command
Mark tasks with configurable trigger strings (HTML comments, tags, emoji) that select the action
Append archived tasks to a configurable archive file, created if missing
Support both Tasks emoji recurrence format and Dataview-format inline fields
extras: The README warns the plugin is unlikely to do anything useful without the Tasks plugin, and suggests assigning a hotkey or pinning the command in the Command Palette for convenience.
intentEvidence: Packrat is unlikely to do anything useful if you aren't using the Tasks plugin in your Obsidian vault
motivation: The author categorized their completed recurring tasks into three handling preferences (delete, move to bottom, archive separately) and wanted the cleanup automated per task.
problem: The Tasks plugin keeps inserting new instances of recurring tasks, so completed instances accumulate and clutter the note where they originate.

relations.evidence: the amazing and (for many) indispensable Tasks plugin
Packrat supports both Tasks' traditional emojis and Dataview-format inline fields

summary: Cleanup tool that deletes, relocates, or archives completed instances of recurring Tasks-plugin tasks in the active note.
